method: Direct visual inspection of all fourteen QA16 rendered pages, followed by exact pixel-hash comparison of every QA17 page. QA17 differs only in PDF file metadata after a STATUS documentation change.

page_findings.1: Displayed title, author, abstract and introduction legible. Abstract identifies the kinetic-energy-only control and uses precise group-count wording.
page_findings.2: Target, geometry, condition equation and Figure 1 checked; no clipping or detached caption.
page_findings.3: Prior separate test-partition inspection is disclosed next to the no-test-events-in-this-analysis statement; Figure 2 checked.
page_findings.4: Response, activity and flow equations 2-6 remain legible and within margins.
page_findings.5: Equations 7-11, generation order and channel-placement account checked.
page_findings.6: Decoder/loss equations 12-13 and training protocol checked.
page_findings.7: Gap equation 14 and classifier control explicitly define incident kinetic energy alone; references and caveats legible.
page_findings.8: Table 1, response text and all Figure 3 labels/captions checked.
page_findings.9: Figure 4(c1) says last active layer, consistent with Table 1, surrounding prose and caption; panels and numbers legible.
page_findings.10: Graph, classifier and closure results and discussion opening checked; screening criterion wording consistent.
page_findings.11: Three independent generator-training seeds are distinguished from classifier seeds; detector/timing and conclusion opening legible.
page_findings.12: Conclusion continuation, availability, acknowledgments, AI disclosure and Table 2 checked.
page_findings.13: Appendix A/B, response bins and classifier-seed Table 4 checked; caption uses screening criterion of 0.65.
page_findings.14: All 25 references legible with complete identifiers and no overflow.

findings: No clipping, overlap, missing glyph, figure/caption mismatch, unresolved reference or unreadable label observed. Natural Conclusion continuation across pages 11-12 accepted.
